families.estimand: Gross or net change in the declared expected-value, utility, CVaR, chance-constrained, or minimax-regret objective between matched current and post-information feasible policy problems.
families.conditioning_and_units: Risk functional, objective direction, constraint units, feasible set, information state, and cost placement are fixed across states; result units are the declared objective units.
limitations: no stable-promotion or cross-language parity claim

families.estimand: Expected decision-value gain from a declared probabilistic forecast or signal at a stated horizon, freshness, and latency, net of declared cost; predictive accuracy alone is not value.
families.conditioning_and_units: The joint forecast-outcome law, operational objective, information time, horizon, and cost placement are fixed; result units are the declared operational objective units.
limitations: no stable-promotion or cross-language parity claim

families.estimand: Gross or net decision value of an optimized feasible bundle or sequence of dependent information sources, including conditional marginal value and attribution.
families.conditioning_and_units: Sources share a declared joint observation model, decision-value unit, timing, rights state, and cost basis; independent additive EVSI is not assumed.
limitations: rights and ordering pathologies fail closed
no stable-promotion or cross-language parity claim
